admission.justification: The obligation is realized in kernel/git_command.py for the sanctioned Git argv, commit_check_process.py for the bounded session and log, _code_merge_commit.py for the conditional stamp, bounded commit, and mutation rollback, _merge.py for delegation, and sync_transaction.py for the typed refusal, and the continued-sync hook cases in test_sync_commit_check.py guard it.

applicability: A code-side sync continued after a resolved conflict, whose commit runs the repository's pre-commit check.
conditions: The sync is continued through worktree_sync with resolution_action='continue'.
The commit reaches the repository's own commit check; the memory-side merge commit keeps its own hooks.
exclusions: The memory-side merge commit, which runs in the memory repository under its own hooks.
A commit the product does not run through the repository's commit check.

evidence: PYTHONPATH=mcp/test_support mcp/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -m "" -q (15 focused modules) -> 237 passed, 82 subtests passed in 234.93s (test_sync_commit_check.py: 14 passed)
Reviewer R3 PASS WITH NOTES on 05acc9a7 (L29-W3-final-checks-05acc9a7.log: 243 passed, 84 subtests passed; test_sync_commit_check.py: 17 passed)

statement: A continued code-side sync commit runs git commit -m carrying Commit-Check-Pass: tree=<tree> hook=<hook> when a runnable pre-commit hook exists and git commit --no-edit without a stamp when none does (never --no-verify), in its own process session under orchestration.landing.commitCheckTimeoutSeconds (default 900s), terminates its process group after a 30s grace and cleans up or names escaped output holders, refuses tracked-file mutations, retains the hook log under the Git common directory, and returns sync-commit-check-failed while keeping HEAD, MERGE_HEAD, and the staged merge intact.
title: A continued sync commit is bounded and keeps its staged merge
